nd54d2ff5ba.why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of India's National Stock Exchange, tracking its largest listed companies. Crude oil price moves affect costs for Indian oil, chemical and transport firms.
nd54d2ff5ba.why_moved: Crude oil softened and short covering supported buying, according to the report. Gains in defence, oil-gas and chemical stocks lifted the index while IT stocks lagged.

n8069996621.why: Gold is a major store of value and a large source of demand in India, so local prices reflect global bullion prices and import duties.

ndb4e466afd.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Governor Sanjay Malhotra will announce a repo rate decision on Thursday at 10 am. Speculation points to a possible rise in home loan EMIs after four consecutive meetings.
ndb4e466afd.why: The Reserve Bank of India sets the benchmark repo rate that anchors borrowing costs across the Indian economy and influences rupee-denominated bond yields.

n378a4cb91f.why: The ruling sets a legal precedent for how travel intermediaries handle refunds, affecting fee practices in Israel's travel sector.
